name: Hafiz Muhammad Soban Khan
bio: Hafiz Muhammad Soban Khan is a Research Engineer I at the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence. His work focuses on cybersecurity for embedded systems, industrial control systems, and critical infrastructure, with expertise in AI-driven vulnerability detection, penetration testing, and fuzzing. He previously worked at ENCS in the Netherlands as a Cybersecurity Engineer and holds an MSc in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Cyprus. His research centres on improving the security and resilience of cyber-physical and smart energy systems.
shortBio: Research engineer working on embedded systems, ICS security, and AI-driven vulnerability detection.
